# Moritz Rossmanith — Abstract Artist

> Moritz Rossmanith is a German-Australian abstract artist based in Ulm, Germany. He paints emotions in explosive layers of neon acrylic and spray paint on canvas. Many works transform under UV light. His paintings continue across the edges of the canvas.

Raised as a third culture kid in Singapore, Bangkok, New York, Milan, Stockholm, New Zealand and Hong Kong, Rossmanith works explosively: spraying, pouring, throwing and brushing layer over layer. Painting is his way of expressing feelings — raw, bright and positive. In real life the works are far more vivid than photos can show.
